adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` which uses `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then `usernames.split(",")...` followed by a `group.save` with a `render_json_error(group)` else-branch. In the updated spec, there are tests for automatic-group rejection and successful add of multiple users, but no test covers the behavior when `:usernames` is missing (which would raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing`) or when `usernames` is blank/empty, nor any test forces `group.save` to fail to exercise the `render_json_error` branch. This is a specific, diff-grounded missing-test/edge-case coverage concern rather than a demonstrated defect.
